### Cohort and Charlson Comorbidity Creation with Gender Statistics
```{r}
micu_patients <- icu |>
  filter(first_careunit == "Medical Intensive Care Unit (MICU)") |>
  group_by(subject_id) |>
  slice_min(order_by = intime, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  inner_join(patients, by = "subject_id") |>
  filter(
    anchor_age >= 18, # Restrict analysis to adult patients
    !is.na(anchor_age), # Remove records with missing age
    !is.na(gender) # Remove records with missing gender
  ) |>
  mutate(
    days_death = sql("DATE_DIFF(CAST(dod AS DATE), CAST(intime AS DATE), DAY)"),
    mortality_30_days = ifelse(!is.na(dod) & days_death <= 30, 1, 0)
  )

micu_patients_local <- micu_patients |> collect()

diagnosis_subset <- diagnosis |>
  semi_join(micu_patients, by = "hadm_id") |>
  select(hadm_id, icd_code, icd_version) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
icd9_subset <- diagnosis_subset |> filter(icd_version == 9)
icd10_subset <- diagnosis_subset |> filter(icd_version == 10)

cci_icd9 <- comorbidity(
  x = icd9_subset,
  id = "hadm_id",
  code = "icd_code",
  map = "charlson_icd9_quan",
  assign0 = FALSE
)

cci_icd10 <- comorbidity(
  x = icd10_subset,
  id = "hadm_id",
  code = "icd_code",
  map = "charlson_icd10_quan",
  assign0 = FALSE
)

cci_icd9$charlson_score <- score(
  cci_icd9,
  weights = "quan",
  assign0 = FALSE
)

cci_icd10$charlson_score <- score(
  cci_icd10,
  weights = "quan",
  assign0 = FALSE
)

# Merge ICD-9 and ICD-10 Charlson scores, keeping the highest per admission
charlson_combined <- bind_rows(
  cci_icd9 |> select(hadm_id, charlson_score),
  cci_icd10 |> select(hadm_id, charlson_score)
) |>
  group_by(hadm_id) |>
  summarise(charlson_score = max(charlson_score), .groups = "drop")

micu_cohort_final <- micu_patients_local |>
  left_join(charlson_combined, by = "hadm_id") |>
  mutate(charlson_score = replace_na(charlson_score, 0))
```

### Vital Sign Feature Extraction
```{r}
# Pull first-24-hour vital signs recorded during the initial MICU stay
vital_codes <- c(
  220045, # Heart rate
  220210, # Respiratory rate
  220277, # SpO2
  223761, # Temperature Fahrenheit
  220052, # Mean arterial pressure
  220179, # Non-invasive systolic BP
  220180, # Non-invasive diastolic BP
  220181, # Non-invasive mean BP
  226512 # Admission weight (kg)
)

vital_data_query <- tbl(con_bq, "chartevents") |>
  filter(itemid %in% vital_codes) |>
  inner_join(
    micu_patients |> select(stay_id, intime),
    by = "stay_id"
  ) |>
  filter(charttime >= intime) |>
  filter(charttime <= sql("DATETIME_ADD(intime, INTERVAL 24 HOUR)")) |>
  mutate(
    vital_name = case_when(
      itemid == 220045 ~ "HR",
      itemid == 220210 ~ "RR",
      itemid == 220277 ~ "SpO2",
      itemid == 223761 ~ "Temp_F",
      itemid == 220052 ~ "Arterial_BP_Mean",
      itemid == 220179 ~ "NIBP_Systolic",
      itemid == 220180 ~ "NIBP_Diastolic",
      itemid == 220181 ~ "NIBP_Mean",
      itemid == 226512 ~ "Weight_kg"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(stay_id, vital_name) |>
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(valuenum, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

vital_data_local <- vital_data_query |>
  collect() |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = vital_name,
    values_from = mean_value,
    names_glue = "{vital_name}_{.value}"
  )

micu_cohort_final <- micu_cohort_final |>
  left_join(vital_data_local, by = "stay_id")
```

### Vasopressor Use and Intubation Features Extraction
```{r}
vasopressor_codes <- c(
  221906, # Norepinephrine
  221289, # Epinephrine
  221749, # Phenylephrine
  222315, # Vasopressin
  221662 # Dopamine
)

intubation_codes <- c(
  224385 # Intubation
)

input_events <- tbl(con_bq, "inputevents")
procedure_events <- tbl(con_bq, "procedureevents")

vasopressor_query <- input_events |>
  filter(itemid %in% vasopressor_codes) |>
  inner_join(
    micu_patients |> select(stay_id, intime),
    by = "stay_id"
  ) |>
  # Restrict medications to the first 24 hours after ICU admission
  filter(starttime >= intime) |>
  filter(starttime <= sql("DATETIME_ADD(intime, INTERVAL 24 HOUR)")) |>
  group_by(stay_id) |>
  summarise(vaso_active = 1, .groups = "drop")

intubation_data_query <- procedure_events |>
  filter(itemid %in% intubation_codes) |>
  inner_join(
    micu_patients |> select(stay_id, intime),
    by = "stay_id"
  ) |>
  # Restrict procedures to the first 24 hours after ICU admission
  filter(starttime >= intime) |>
  filter(starttime <= sql("DATETIME_ADD(intime, INTERVAL 24 HOUR)")) |>
  group_by(stay_id) |>
  summarise(intubated = 1, .groups = "drop")

vasopressor_local <- vasopressor_query |> collect()
intubation_local <- intubation_data_query |> collect()

micu_cohort_final <- micu_cohort_final |>
  left_join(vasopressor_local, by = "stay_id") |>
  left_join(intubation_local, by = "stay_id") |>
  mutate(
    vaso_active = replace_na(vaso_active, 0),
    intubated = replace_na(intubated, 0)
  )
```
### Urine Output Feature Extraction
```{r}
urine_query <- tbl(con_bq, "outputevents") |>
  inner_join(
    micu_patients |> select(stay_id, intime),
    by = "stay_id"
  ) |>
  filter(charttime >= intime) |>
  filter(charttime <= sql("DATETIME_ADD(intime, INTERVAL 24 HOUR)")) |>
  group_by(stay_id) |>
  summarise(urine_output_24h = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

urine_local <- urine_query |> collect()

micu_cohort_final <- micu_cohort_final |>
  left_join(urine_local, by = "stay_id") |>
  # Assume zero if no urine output was recorded
  mutate(urine_output_24h = replace_na(urine_output_24h, 0))
```

### Missing Data Imputation and Feature Preparation
```{r}
# Prepare modeling dataset and handle missing values
# Median imputation is applied to numeric predictors and mode imputation to factors
ml_data <- micu_cohort_final |>
  # Remove identifiers and variables not used for prediction
  select(
    -subject_id, -hadm_id, -stay_id,
    -intime, -outtime, -dod, -days_death,
    -los, -first_careunit, -last_careunit
  ) |>
  mutate(
    mortality_30_days = factor(
      mortality_30_days,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Survived", "Died")
    ),
    gender = as.factor(gender)
  )

set.seed(123) # Ensure reproducible train/test split
data_split <- initial_split(
  ml_data,
  prop = 0.8,
  strata = mortality_30_days
)

train_data <- training(data_split)
test_data <- testing(data_split)

temp_recipe <- recipe(mortality_30_days ~ ., data = train_data) |>
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_impute_mode(all_nominal_predictors())

train_imputed_mi <- bake(prep(temp_recipe), new_data = NULL)

mi_scores <- information_gain(
  mortality_30_days ~ .,
  data = train_imputed_mi,
  type = "infogain"
) |>
  arrange(desc(importance))

top_features <- mi_scores |>
  filter(importance > 0) |>
  pull(attributes)

impute_rec <- recipe(mortality_30_days ~ ., data = train_data) |>
  step_select(mortality_30_days, any_of(top_features)) |>
  # Median imputation for continuous predictors
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  # Mode imputation for categorical predictors
  step_impute_mode(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  # Convert categorical predictors into dummy variables
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  # Remove predictors with zero variance
  step_zv(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  # Standardize numeric predictors
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

impute_prep <- prep(impute_rec)

train_imputed <- bake(impute_prep, new_data = NULL)
test_imputed <- bake(impute_prep, new_data = test_data)
```

### Mutual Information Scores Ranking of Predictive Features
```{r}
# Recalculate mutual information after preprocessing
# Higher values indicate stronger contribution to mortality prediction
mi_scores <- information_gain(
  mortality_30_days ~ .,
  data = train_imputed,
  type = "infogain"
) |>
  arrange(desc(importance))

# Plot the top 20 ranked predictors
feature_importance_plot <- mi_scores |>
  slice_head(n = 20) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(attributes, importance), y = importance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 20 Predictors by Mutual Information",
    subtitle = "30-Day Mortality Prediction in MICU Patients",
    x = "Predictor",
    y = "Information Gain"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# feature_importance_plot

head(mi_scores, max(nrow(mi_scores)))
```

### Predictive Models for the Full Cohort
```{r}
# Logistic regression model with elastic net tuning
logit_mod <- logistic_reg(
  penalty = tune(),
  mixture = tune()
) |>
  set_engine("glmnet", standardize = FALSE) |>
  print()

# Random forest model
rf_mod <-
  rand_forest(
    mode = "classification",
    # Number of predictors sampled at each split
    mtry = tune(),
    # Number of trees included in the ensemble
    trees = tune()
  ) |>
  set_engine("ranger")
rf_mod

# Gradient boosting model (XGBoost)
gb_mod <-
  boost_tree(
    mode = "classification",
    trees = 300,
    tree_depth = tune(),
    learn_rate = tune()
  ) |>
  set_engine("xgboost")
gb_mod
```
```{r}
param_grid_logit <- grid_regular(
  penalty(range = c(-6, 3)),
  mixture(),
  levels = c(30, 5)
) |>
  print()

param_grid_rf <- grid_regular(
  trees(range = c(100L, 500L)),
  mtry(range = c(1L, 5L)),
  levels = c(5, 5)
)
param_grid_rf

param_grid_gb <- grid_regular(
  tree_depth(range = c(1L, 3L)),
  learn_rate(range = c(-5, 2), trans = log10_trans()),
  levels = c(3, 10)
)
param_grid_gb

folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5, strata = mortality_30_days)
```
```{r}
logit_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(impute_rec) |>
  add_model(logit_mod) |>
  print()

rf_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(impute_rec) |>
  add_model(rf_mod)
rf_wf

gb_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(impute_rec) |>
  add_model(gb_mod)
gb_wf
```
```{r}
# Parallel tuning across available CPU cores
cl <- makePSOCKcluster(parallel::detectCores() - 1)

registerDoParallel(cl)

(logit_fit <- logit_wf |>
  tune_grid(
    resamples = folds,
    grid = param_grid_logit,
    metrics = metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy)
  )) |>
  system.time()

rf_fit <- rf_wf |>
  tune_grid(
    resamples = folds,
    grid = param_grid_rf,
    metrics = metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy)
  )

gb_fit <- gb_wf |>
  tune_grid(
    resamples = folds,
    grid = param_grid_gb,
    metrics = metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy)
  )

stopCluster(cl)
```

```{r}
    resamples = folds_female,
    grid = param_grid_rf,
    metrics = metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy)
  )

gb_fit_female <- gb_wf_female |>
  tune_grid(
    resamples = folds_female,
    grid = param_grid_gb,
    metrics = metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy)
  )

stopCluster(cl)
```

```{r}
best_logit_male <- logit_fit_male |>
  select_best(metric = "roc_auc")

best_rf_male <- rf_fit_male |>
  select_best(metric = "roc_auc")

best_gb_male <- gb_fit_male |>
  select_best(metric = "roc_auc")
```

```{r}
best_logit_female <- logit_fit_female |>
  select_best(metric = "roc_auc")

best_rf_female <- rf_fit_female |>
  select_best(metric = "roc_auc")

best_gb_female <- gb_fit_female |>
  select_best(metric = "roc_auc")
```

```{r}

  finalize_workflow(best_logit_male)

final_wf_rf_male <- rf_wf_male |>
  finalize_workflow(best_rf_male)

final_wf_gb_male <- gb_wf_male |>
  finalize_workflow(best_gb_male)
```

```{r}

final_wf_gb_female <- gb_wf_female |>
```

### Combined Model Comparison Across Genders
```{r}
# Merge prediction outputs from overall and gender-specific test sets
mimic_cohort_all <- bind_rows(
  # Full cohort models
  collect_predictions(final_fit_logit) |>
    mutate(model = "Logistic Regression", group = "All"),
  collect_predictions(final_fit_rf) |>
    mutate(model = "Random Forest", group = "All"),
  collect_predictions(final_fit_gb) |>
    mutate(model = "XGBoost", group = "All"),

  # Male subgroup models
  collect_predictions(final_fit_logit_male) |>
    mutate(model = "Logistic Regression", group = "Male"),
  collect_predictions(final_fit_rf_male) |>
    mutate(model = "Random Forest", group = "Male"),
  collect_predictions(final_fit_gb_male) |>
    mutate(model = "XGBoost", group = "Male"),

  # Female subgroup models
  collect_predictions(final_fit_logit_female) |>
    mutate(model = "Logistic Regression", group = "Female"),
  collect_predictions(final_fit_rf_female) |>
    mutate(model = "Random Forest", group = "Female"),
  collect_predictions(final_fit_gb_female) |>
    mutate(model = "XGBoost", group = "Female")
)
```

# ROC Comparison Across All Genders and Female/Male Subgroup Models
comparison_plot <- mimic_cohort_all |>
  group_by(model, group) |>
  roc_curve(truth = mortality_30_days, .pred_Survived) |>
  autoplot() +
  facet_wrap(~model) +
  labs(
    title = "Overall vs Gender-Specific Model Performance",
    subtitle = "ROC curves for 30-day mortality after first MICU admission",
    color = "Patient Cohort"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

comparison_plot
